stimulus.title: Cooling the block
stimulus.text:
Paragraph A — A neighborhood library tested pale roof coatings on two small annexes during a hot month. Staff recorded lower afternoon ceiling temperatures in the coated buildings, while the rooms continued to use the same ventilation schedule. The trial was deliberately limited to existing roofs so the library could compare a low-disruption change before considering larger renovations.

Paragraph B — At a nearby transit stop, residents helped place lightweight shade panels above the waiting area. The panels were positioned to block strong afternoon sun without covering the road or changing bus operations. Volunteers later reported that the shaded seats were used more consistently during the hottest part of the day.
